parameters.name: accessToken

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. You can find this ID in the URL of your Alibaba Cloud DevOps page, for example: https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}.

parameters.name: repositoryIdentity
parameters.description: The repository ID or full path.
